extra.reason: Fixed updatePurchase to scope stockMovements update to reason='purchase', added regression test in shopping.test.ts

Added scripts/backup.sh (sqlite .backup + retention prune), docker-compose backups mount, deploy.sh pre-migrate backup step. Cron scheduling on asus-server and live restore test still need to be done manually against production.
Added 10MB Content-Length/file.size cap (413) and magic-byte sniffing against declared MIME type in nutrition photo PUT route
Fixed normalizeStep to return null for null/undefined/empty step timings instead of coercing to 0; added unit tests.
eatFromBatch now returns 'empty' and no-ops (route returns 409) when mealsRemaining<=0, instead of inserting batch_eaten rows past 0
Added DATE_RE validation on POST/PATCH /api/events; invalid dates now return 400 instead of being silently stored
Added DATE_RE validation for startDate/untilDate (with untilDate>=startDate check) and all-zero daysOfWeek rejection in POST /api/rules, mirroring PATCH handler's existing check.

Fixed: updateProduct/updateVariant now return the current row on an empty patch instead of calling drizzle's .set({}), which threw and 500'd. Slots' PATCH already 400s (name is required) so no change needed there.
Wrapped deleteVariant's six writes in db.transaction, matching deleteProduct/deleteRecipe pattern; added rollback test
Extracted assertOwnedRefs into shared src/lib/ownership.ts and wired it into createRule + POST /api/rules (400 on foreign ref), with tests covering each id kind
Fixed deleteEvent to only reverse stock movements when the row is actually removed (scope 'one'), and fixed deleteRule's FK failure on surviving cooked/served events; added regression tests.
POST /api/purchases now rejects non-positive/non-integer quantity with 400, mirroring PATCH validation; added route-level tests
Merged: ownership guard for slotId/item ids in batch endpoints
Merged: RFC5545-compliant UTF-8 safe line folding in buildIcs
registerHousehold now seeds Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner slots in the registration transaction
Added DATE_RE validation and eventIds NaN filtering to /api/nutrition/analysis and /api/nutrition/ingredients
Merged: regex-validated timeOfDay on slot create/update

Fixed check-then-insert race: registerHousehold catches the users_email_unique constraint violation and throws DuplicateEmailError; route returns 409 instead of 500. No new migration needed — unique index already existed in drizzle/0000.
Merged: registration gated behind ALLOW_REGISTRATION + per-IP rate limiting on register/login
Merged: error.tsx, global-error.tsx, not-found.tsx added
Merged: busy_timeout=5000 set on sqlite connection

Wrapped cookEvent's stock-movement writes and status flip in db.transaction (src/lib/plan.ts); added a rollback test forcing failure on the 3rd consumption line, verified it fails without the fix and passes with it.

Added a watermark guard so topUpRules bails with no writes/lookups when every rule is already materialized through the horizon, and hoisted the per-rule skip/taken queries into two household-wide queries for rules that are actually due.
Merged: shopping list groups keyed by shop id, name carried as a field
Merged: toast/confirm sheet replacing all 7 alert()/confirm() call sites
Merged: shared CANONICAL_UNITS list validated on both POST and PATCH
Merged: packSize validated on PATCH, matches POST rules
Merged: /api/import/product 404s in production build
Batched listIngredients stock lookup via stockByIngredient (constant query count); added test for no-movement ingredient
Merged: consumption lines keep fractional amount instead of rounding at write time
Merged: unattributed negative adjustment rejected before the floor swallows it
Merged: DATE_RE validation + 404 on missing/foreign batch (merge-conflict fixup applied alongside concurrent mealsRemaining=0 fix)
Merged: effectivePrice(db, householdId, productId) scoped like sibling helpers
Merged: horizon/offset validated (400), limit capped at 100

Added shared readJson/validate helper (src/lib/validate.ts, no new dependency) covering number/date/enum/string fields with consistent {error} 400s; migrated 4 representative routes (purchases, eaten, ingredients, stock POST) as proof of concept with a full test suite per coerced type. Remaining ~38 routes tracked in follow-up mealpal-akx.1.

Repaired drizzle/meta snapshot drift (added 0037_snapshot.json reflecting true post-0037 schema); db:generate now produces a correct no-op diff and correct minimal migrations, verified with db:migrate against a scratch DB copy; table-rebuild migrations still need the sqlite3 CLI workaround.
Added opt-in search+sort to EntityList (Recipes, Shops, Ingredients, Products, Slots) and a client-side search/sort toggle to the Shop run view, shared across desktop/mobile via useShopData.

Bulk add-meal is now transactional: /api/events and /api/rules accept an array body inserted via addEvents/createRules (single db.transaction, rolls back all-or-nothing, error names the failing index); client posts one request instead of looping.
Implemented g-chord nav, ? cheatsheet, and context-dependent n/[/] shortcuts, desktop-only, in commit b27be71
